sign_in.title: Sign in
sign_in.subtitle: One account for franciscosolis.cl and its services. No passwords — pick a provider and you are in.
sign_in.email_hint: We email you a single-use link that signs you in.
sign_in.provider_unavailable: This provider is not configured on this deployment.
sign_in.no_password: There is no password to forget — every sign-in is a fresh, single-use grant.
sign_in.sent_subtitle: If {{email}} has an account or an invitation, the link is on its way.
sign_in.sent_expiry: It expires in about {{minutes}} minutes and works once.
sign_in.sent_note: Open the link in this browser so the sign-in can finish where it started. You can close this tab afterwards.

authorize.title: Sign in
authorize.subtitle: to continue to {{application}}
authorize.sent_note: Open the link in this browser so the application you came from gets you back. You can close this tab afterwards.
authorize.no_providers: This deployment has no sign-in method configured, so the request cannot be completed.
authorize.loading_subtitle: Reading the request the application handed over.
authorize.invalid_subtitle: This screen is opened by the auth service at the end of an application's sign-in.
authorize.missing_request: This address carries no sign-in request. Start from the application you want to sign in to.
authorize.expired_title: This sign-in request is no longer valid
authorize.expired_subtitle: It may have expired, or it was already finished in another tab.

callback.title: Signing you in
callback.subtitle: Exchanging the authorization code for your session.
callback.error_subtitle: The link may have already been used, or it expired before it was opened.

account.title: Your account
account.subtitle: Your profile, the access you hold and every device currently signed in.
account.profile_description: How your name and picture appear across the services that use this account.
account.email_hint: The email is the identity key providers are matched on, so it cannot be changed here.
account.name_placeholder: How you want to be addressed
account.picture_hint: A direct link to an image. Leave empty to fall back to your initials.
account.locale_hint: BCP 47 tag, e.g. es-CL or en-US.
account.access_description: Roles and permissions you hold for {{application}}.
account.identities_description: The providers linked to this account.
account.sessions_description: Every device signed in to this account. Revoking one invalidates its whole token chain.
account.revoke_body: {{device}} is signed out immediately. Whoever is using it has to sign in again.
account.revoke_current_body: This is the browser you are using. Revoking it signs you out here, right now.

common.forbidden_body: This section needs a permission your account does not hold.

errors.network: The auth service could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
errors.session-expired: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
errors.missing-code: This address is missing the authorization code the provider should have sent.
errors.missing-transaction: This browser has no record of the sign-in that started this link. Start again from the sign-in page.
errors.state-mismatch: The sign-in could not be verified. Start again from the sign-in page.
errors.invalid-email: Enter an email address in the form name@example.com.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.
errors.malformed-response: The service sent an answer this browser could not read. Try again in a moment.
